purpose: Freeze the authority and custody boundary for future P2-U hidden-route naturalistic evaluation before any P2-U naturalistic protected outcome. This tranche removes leakage, denominator, route-deletion, and false-closure degrees of freedom; it does not freeze the final task corpus, metric margins, provider execution manifest, or protected result.

objects.candidate_visible_task: Task prompt plus only the source/search interfaces, public context, and resource budget prospectively declared for that task. Hidden material-route identities, route-completeness labels, evaluator utility weights, hidden evidence labels, and gold closure state are absent.
objects.hidden_route_graph: Evaluator-owned set of prospectively frozen material evidence routes and route dependencies for one task or prospectively frozen task cluster. A route is material only when its evidence can change a predeclared scientific decision, conclusion, uncertainty state, or admissible closure state.
objects.hidden_evidence_item: Evaluator-owned source snapshot or evidence record assigned to one or more material routes, with immutable source identity, retrieval-independent content hash where legally retainable, provenance, validity status, and predeclared decision relevance.
objects.system_capture: Immutable candidate or comparator search/retrieval/use/answer trace produced without access to hidden route labels or gold closure state.
objects.closure_decision: The system's task-global state at the frozen cutoff: COMPLETE/CLOSED, OPEN/INCOMPLETE, CANNOT_CHECK/ABSTAIN, or an equivalent mapping frozen before outcomes. Evaluator authority remains separate from the system declaration.

may_see: full source universe used to construct hidden routes
must_not: run or tune candidate/comparator after protected outputs are opened
delete or relabel a route because it harms a system after outcome
serve as the sole final independent scorer

may_see: their own system state and outputs
must_not_see: other arm's protected outcome before their own output freezes

must_not: alter task/route eligibility after observing system identity or result
grant publication, registry, merge, or issue-closure authority

must_reconstruct: final reported metrics from immutable captures
must_not_import: candidate policy code as scoring authority
original evaluator terminal function as an oracle

pre_outcome_freeze_order: Freeze final task or task-cluster identities and eligibility rules.
Freeze hidden route graph and hidden evidence identities outside candidate/comparator custody.
Freeze exact candidate/comparator implementations, matched source/search interfaces, host/model identities, and total task budgets in the separate execution manifest.
Freeze metric definitions, uncertainty procedure, multiplicity policy, superiority/noninferiority margins, invalidity rules, and task-level terminal mapping in a separate scientific protocol.
Hash/seal all above before any protected candidate/comparator execution.
Run candidate/comparator workers without hidden route/gold access.
Freeze each system capture and output bytes before hidden route/evaluator material enters the scoring environment.
Only then permit protected evaluation and independent reconstruction.

information_and_budget_parity.reason_no_shared_capture: P2-U asks whether systems discover more decision-relevant evidence under matched access and budget. Giving all arms one shared retrieved set would remove part of the causal target. Equality is at source/tool/access/budget level, while each arm's search trajectory remains its own frozen outcome.
charged_work: wall time under the frozen policy
information_and_budget_parity.evaluator_only_work_not_charged_to_syste: Gold-only route adjudication/scoring performed after output freeze, because no arm may access it during execution.

route_and_denominator_integrity.inferential_unit: research task or prospectively frozen task cluster
route_and_denominator_integrity.provider_invalid_or_transport_invalid_ta: CANNOT_CHECK_OR_PROTOCOL_INVALID_PER_FROZEN_RULE; never score as a scientific miss, success, or equality by convenience.
route_and_denominator_integrity.missing_hidden_route_evidence_due_to_cur: CANNOT_CHECK; never assume the route is absent.
route_and_denominator_integrity.duplicate_sources: May map to the same underlying evidence identity but cannot inflate route recall, evidence count, or inferential n.
route_and_denominator_integrity.retrieved_but_unprocessed: Distinct from not retrieved. It counts as discovered only under the separately frozen discovery metric, and cannot count as decision-relevant use unless the immutable use trace proves processing under the frozen definition.
route_and_denominator_integrity.contradictory_sources: Retain both sides and evaluator provenance. A system may not receive route-completeness credit merely for retrieving one side of a frozen material contradiction.

false_closure_boundary.false_closure_candidate: A system declares the task closed/complete or emits the protocol-mapped equivalent while at least one evaluator-frozen material route remains undiscovered, unprocessed, unresolved, contradicted without discharge, or provider-invalid in a way that the frozen closure rule requires to remain OPEN/CANNOT_CHECK.
false_closure_boundary.reason: P2-U must show discovery value without winning solely by refusing closure. Scientific utility/answer quality and discovery metrics remain co-primary or guarded according to the later frozen scientific protocol.

anti_laundering_checks: A route label or gold closure field appearing in a worker-visible packet is an invalid campaign, not a positive or negative result.
A hidden route added after one arm's protected output is opened cannot be used in the same campaign version.
A hidden route removed or downgraded after any protected output is opened invalidates the campaign version.
A comparator receiving less source access, search budget, model/tool capability, or donor functionality than frozen for the primary causal comparison invalidates that causal comparison.
A candidate receiving privileged route hints, curator vocabulary, hidden source identities, or evaluator feedback invalidates the campaign.

A provider outage or malformed response cannot be converted into evidence absence or a zero-recall task unless the separate frozen scientific protocol explicitly and prospectively defines that provider state as part of the task world.
Repeated samples/traces/retries cannot be promoted into independent task n.
The original evaluator cannot certify its own implementation as an independent reproduction.
A public benchmark score cannot substitute for hidden-route naturalistic authority.
A narrow P2 Wide positive or negative cannot modify this P2-U hidden-route contract.
required_successor_freezes_before_p2_u_r: P2-U final naturalistic task/task-cluster corpus and source-snapshot manifest
P2-U exact execution manifest binding host/model/tool/provider/comparator revisions and total budgets
